blurb: A whole DOS machine in one folder (DOSBox Pure via EmulatorJS, embedded unmodified) whose playable home is this box — its core is a threaded build that needs cross-origin isolation, which the box sends and a static site cannot. Zip up a DOS drive folder and the console mounts it as C: and boots to a prompt; or hand it a single game zip. Freeze a moment and hand the next player its DOS State Code (the lesson measures one at 196,650 characters — a light baton). The state carries the machine, not the drive files: the next player mounts the same zip first.
title: The DOS Console
